Title: Casserole en acier inoxydable
Description: Casserole en acier inoxydable 18/10 avec fond encapsulé en aluminium qui répartit la chaleur uniformément et convient à l'induction. Title: Felt Cat Cave
Description: Cat cave hand-felted from 100% merino wool in Nepal, thick enough to hold its dome shape without a frame. The wool breathes, so it stays cool in summer and warm in winter, and the 40 cm opening suits cats up to about 6 kg. Fair-trade certified through the workshop that makes them.
Category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Pet Beds
Care: Spot clean with a damp cloth; air in the sun to freshen. Reshape by hand while damp.
